_comment: Description and badge transcribed from the in-game Custom Search screen with this mode selected, captured 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805231925).
name: Team Deathmatch
_alias_note: No bare "deathmatch" alias: Squad Deathmatch is a separate mode and 1.3.3.0 names both in one line.

description.text: Face off against an enemy team in a close-quarters firefight where hostiles must be eliminated.

_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Cut from the same capture as the description.
